headline_item.title_zh: OpenAI修复定价漏洞，GPT-6.2 Astra用户额度缩减
headline_item.title_en: GPT-6.2 Astra users now hit limits 40% faster after OpenAI patched a pricing error
headline_item.author: Matthias Bastian
headline_item.event_summary_zh: OpenAI因定价计算错误修复漏洞，导致GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol模型用户配额消耗速度分别提升40%与25%
headline_item.event_summary_en: OpenAI engineer Thibault Sottiaux confirmed that a billing bug during the GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol rollout has been rectified. The fix results in a 40% and 25% faster consumption rate for Astra and Sol quotas respectively, while the company provides extra resets and free Fast Mode access for subscribers as compensation.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI公司代码工程师Thibault Sottiaux在OpenAI产品定价与模型服务平台：修复GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol计费漏洞，调整用户配额消耗速率，并补偿订阅权益
【起因与机理】因计算错误导致的定价逻辑偏差，导致公司实际收入与模型算力消耗不匹配
【关键数据与实测】Astra配额消耗加速40%，Sol加速25%。
【各方立场与态度】针对Go/Plus/Pro/Business用户提供额外配额重置及Fast Mode权益补偿。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Thibault Sottiaux, OpenAI Codex Engineer: Fixed billing bug, adjusted quota consumption rates, and issued subscription compensations
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Inaccurate pricing logic leading to a discrepancy between revenue and compute costs
[Key Metrics] 40% faster consumption for Astra and 25% for Sol.
[Key Position & Outlook] Compensation via additional resets and free Fast Mode access.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此事件反映出AI服务商在向复杂Agentic（代理）架构转型时，对推理算力成本评估存在高度不确定性。将Chat与Work模式合并的尝试表明，OpenAI正试图通过动态分配算力逻辑以压低边际成本，但这直接增加了模型调度的复杂性与不可预测的Token消耗压力。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This incident underscores the inherent uncertainty in quantifying inference compute costs as providers pivot to complex Agentic architectures. The move to merge Chat and Work modes demonstrates OpenAI's attempt to optimize marginal costs via dynamic compute allocation, which simultaneously introduces architectural complexity and volatile token consumption profiles.

headlines.title_zh: SAP拟再度裁员超万人以深化AI重组
headlines.title_en: SAP Weighs Cutting at Least 10,000 Positions in AI Restructuring
headlines.author: Bloomberg
headlines.event_summary_zh: SAP正考虑裁减至少1万名员工，旨在通过组织架构重组，强制性加速企业业务向云计算与AI角色转型
headlines.event_summary_en: SAP CEO Christian Klein and CFO Dominik Asam are evaluating a restructuring plan to cut at least 10,000 positions, aiming to accelerate the firm's pivot toward cloud and AI-oriented roles. This initiative deviates from the previous 'Project Mongoose' strategy, which targeted incremental 1-2% annual workforce reductions to address execution lags in the earlier 'Next Level Transformation' program.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】SAP首席执行官Christian Klein、首席财务官Dominik Asam在企业内部组织重组计划：拟裁减至少1万个工作岗位以强化AI与云业务布局
【起因与机理】此前转型计划执行进度不及预期，需通过激进的结构重组实现生产力跃升
【关键数据与实测】企业拟裁减超1万名员工，约为总人数的10%。
【各方立场与态度】战略重心全面转向AI生产力驱动的云服务业务。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Christian Klein (CEO) and Dominik Asam (CFO) of SAP (Internal corporate restructuring): Considering cutting at least 10,000 roles to accelerate AI/cloud transition
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Previous transformation execution fell behind; radical structural adjustment needed for productivity
[Key Metrics] Plan to cut at least 10,000 roles, roughly 10% of global headcount.
[Key Position & Outlook] Core focus shifted to AI-driven productivity gains in cloud services.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: SAP此举反映了成熟软件巨头在AI转型期的激进式博弈，即通过非线性的裁员手段迅速降低冗余人力成本，以释放资本投入高昂的GPU算力资产与AI应用研发。这种“断腕式”调整不仅是财务优化，更是为了在企业级软件市场实现从传统ERP向AI原生服务的范式迁移，以此抵御云原生初创公司的竞争侵蚀。
headlines.industry_impact_en: SAP's move reflects a radical shift in legacy software giants aiming to optimize capital allocation by trading redundant headcount for AI-native infrastructure investment. This structural pivot is a necessary trade-off to facilitate the transition from legacy ERP to AI-first services, effectively buffering against competitive erosion from agile cloud-native challengers.

headlines.title_zh: Rockstar游戏工会化提议被否决
headlines.title_en: UK workers at Rockstar Games vote against a union recognition deal, with only 25% voting in favor; source: 1,544 employees, or 93.2% of eligible workers, voted (Chris Kerr/Vertical Slice)
headlines.author: Vertical Slice
headlines.event_summary_zh: Rockstar Games英国工作室员工投票否决了与RGWU工会的承认协议，75%的员工投下反对票
headlines.event_summary_en: 1,544 employees at Rockstar Games UK voted against recognizing the Rockstar Game Workers Union (RGWU) as their official bargaining body. Despite the high-profile launch of GTA VI, 75% of voters rejected the proposal, meaning management remains under no obligation to engage in formal union negotiations.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Rockstar Games英国工作室员工；Rockstar游戏工会(RGWU)；独立英国工人工会(IWGB)在英国游戏行业：投票否决了工会承认协议，仅25%支持，管理层与工会间的正式谈判机制未能达成
【起因与机理】员工倾向于维持直接沟通模式，且部分员工对工会整合存疑，倾向于保留现行薪酬与HR管理架构
【关键数据与实测】Rockstar英国工作室员工投票否决工会承认协议，反对率达75%。
【各方立场与态度】管理层与工会间的强制性谈判框架未能建立，工会将继续以非正式形式存在。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Rockstar Games UK employees; RGWU; IWGB (UK video game sector): Voted against union recognition with a 75% 'no' result, blocking formal bargaining rights
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Preference for direct management-employee relations and lack of consensus on union value proposition
[Key Metrics] Rockstar UK employees rejected union recognition with 75% voting against.
[Official Stance & Demand] Formal negotiation requirements are off the table, with the union maintaining non-recognized status.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此结果反映了超大型单机游戏工作室内部独特的精英文化与“高回报-高强度”共识，削弱了工会运动在顶级商业开发场景中的渗透力。在全球大型游戏公司面临版权与工会化的双重冲击背景下，该投票表明短期内头部IP的商业稳定性仍优先于劳工组织集体话语权。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The outcome underscores the unique 'high-performance' culture within elite game studios, where the lure of massive commercial success often outweighs the desire for formal collective bargaining. It suggests that in the current hyper-competitive AAA development landscape, direct employment stability remains a stronger gravitational force than unionization for top-tier talent.

celebrity.author: karpathy
celebrity.author_role_zh: AI 极客 / 社区开发者
celebrity.quote_zh:
我要求克劳德用来自美国的真实数据填充文明风格的游戏地图。 Opus 5.5 下载并解析了大量公共数据以及 7 小时和 45K 行代码……它可以工作了:)

- 31 个真实数据源，包括人口普查、BEA、BLS、EIA、NOAA、USGS、DoD、NPS、FAA、FEMA、CDC...
- 实际海拔、土地覆盖、GDP、就业、发电厂、矿山、港口、机场、基地、公园、大学、货运、灾害；所有这些都被协调到一个 25 公里的六角网格上。
- 数据被转换成文明语言，例如黄金收益率就是GDP。一个城市的地区是其真正的行业专业化：圣何塞有一个园区，底特律是“汽车城”。它的公民是真正的劳动力：圣何塞四分之一的工人是工程师、编码员或科学家，而全国只有四分之一。奇观是根据公布的规则来选择的，例如国家公园是根据游客数量来选择的，大学是根据研发支出来选择的，等等。
- 19 个镜头（收入、学位、信仰、灾难……）、524 条地铁的城市景观，以及 9 名顾问和 1 名探险家。 Explorer 将 3,100 多个县中任何一个县的任何列转换为链接到地图的表格和散点图。
- 克劳德决定跳过一些州和领地
- 使用 Claude Code 桌面应用程序、Opus 5.5 在介质上构建并打开超级代码。

它部署在这里：https://karpathy.ai/usaciv/ 和“？”也有源码链接。我不太清楚我要做什么，但浏览和玩起来真的很有趣。也许它可以扩展或内置到游戏中。我每周的克劳德引言只剩下一半了，所以其他人必须接替:D。克劳德还制作了预告片：
celebrity.quote_en:
I asked Claude to populate a Civilization-style game map with real data from the US. Opus 5.5 downloaded and parse a ton of public data and 7 hours and 45K lines of code later... it works :)

- 31 real data sources including Census, BEA, BLS, EIA, NOAA, USGS, DoD, NPS, FAA, FEMA, CDC...
- Real elevation, land cover, GDP, jobs, power plants, mines, ports, airports, bases, parks, universities, freight flows, disasters; all reconciled onto one 25 km hex grid.
- The data is converted into Civilization language, e.g. Gold yield is GDP. A city's districts are its real industry specializations: San Jose gets a Campus, Detroit is "Motor city". Its citizens are its real workforce: 1 in 4 San Jose workers are engineers, coders or scientists, against 1 in 14 nationally. Wonders are chosen by published rules, such as national parks by visitor numbers and universities by R&D spending, etc etc.
- 19 lenses (income, degrees, faith, disasters…), a City View for 524 metros, and nine advisors plus an Explorer. The Explorer turns any column for any of 3,100+ counties into a table and scatter plot, linked to the map.
- Claude decided to skip a few states and territories sry
- Built using Claude Code desktop app, Opus 5.5 on medium and turning on ultracode.

It's deployed here: https://karpathy.ai/usaciv/ and the "?" has the source link too. I don't exactly know where I was going with this but it's really fun to browse and play with. Possibly it can be expanded or built into a game. I only have half of my weekly Claude quote left though so someone else will have to take over :D. Claude also made a trailer:

到这一点后完全重置了他们的公司或从头开始重建它

例如，我记得 Replit 只是一个可以与其他人（针对编码员）一起使用的在线 IDE，它受到了编码教师的青睐，然后在 2024 年，@amasad 将其转变为面向相反受众（非编码员）的 AI 应用程序和网站生成器，这引起了很多强烈反对，但这确实有效，现在预计到今年年底，ARR 将达到 10 亿美元！

无论如何，我们正处于一个全新的时代，对于哪些企业将生存、哪些企业将消亡的动态完全不同，去年有效的方法今年可能不再有效，今年有效的方法明年可能不再有效，因为我们正在处理每年都呈指数级增长的人工智能模型

titans.quote_zh:
许多企业主、创始人和首席执行官现在需要与自己进行艰难的对话，他们的企业根本没有理由在这个新时代继续存在

我认为在后 AGI 时代取得成功的企业（和个人）类型可能完全不同

你现在更好地理解了几年前许多公司对人工智能的极其激进的转向，在意识到这一点后完全重置了他们的公司或从头开始重建它

例如，我记得 Replit 只是一个可以与其他人（针对编码员）一起使用的在线 IDE，它受到了编码教师的青睐，然后在 2024 年，@amasad 将其转变为面向相反受众（非编码员）的 AI 应用程序和网站生成器，这引起了很多强烈反对，但这确实有效，现在预计到今年年底，ARR 将达到 10 亿美元！

无论如何，我们正处于一个全新的时代，对于哪些企业将生存、哪些企业将消亡的动态完全不同，去年有效的方法今年可能不再有效，今年有效的方法明年可能不再有效，因为我们正在处理每年都呈指数级增长的人工智能模型
titans.quote_en:
A lot of business owners, founders and CEOs now need to have the difficult conversation with themselves that their business simply doesn't have a reason to exist anymore in this new era

I think the types of businesses (and people) that succeed in a post-AGI era might just be completely different

You understand better now the extremely aggressive pivots to AI many companies a few years ago did, completely resetting their company or rebuilding it from scratch after they realized this

I remember Replit for example was just an online IDE that you could use with other people (targeted to coders), it got big with coding teachers, then in 2024 @amasad hard pivoted it to be an AI app and site generator target to the opposite audience: non-coders, which caused lots of backlash, but that worked, now it's projected to hit $1B ARR by end of this year!

Anyway, we're in a completely new era with completely different dynamics for what businesses will survive and which will perish, what worked last year might not work this year anymore, and what works this year might not work next year anymore, because we're dealing with AI models that get exponentially better every year
